subject: Energy
title: Renewable Energy Mandates
description: A 60-second lesson on Renewable Energy Mandates.

hook.text: Renewable portfolio standards require utilities to source a share of electricity from renewables—a key policy lever.

buildup.text: Over 170 countries have adopted renewable energy targets—ranging from 20% to 100% of electricity by various dates.

discovery.text: Mandates create guaranteed demand—giving investors confidence to finance wind and solar projects at scale.

twist.text: Some mandates have been weakened or rolled back under political pressure—energy policy swings with election cycles.

climax.text: The most ambitious targets aim for 100% clean electricity by 2035–2050—requiring massive buildout and grid upgrades.

punchline.text: Set the target, build the market—mandates drive deployment.

quiz.question: What do renewable portfolio standards require?
options: A percentage of electricity from renewable sources
